label: Side Pleats with Double Darts
description: Side pleats with double darts combine rear knife pleats near the shoulder blades with two shaping darts lower down the back. The pleats add ease across the upper back while the darts nip in the waist, giving both comfort up top and a tapered fit below. This hybrid back offers movement and a tailored silhouette at once.
